brands.name: Cooper Surfboards
brands.short_description: Independent Newquay, Cornwall shaper. Ollie Cooper has built custom surfboards since 2012.

models.name: Electric Twin
models.description: The Electric Twin is the most versatile fish shape available; extremely refined, short, and wide. It’s my personal favourite that I surf 90% of the time in the UK.

models.name: Fresh Fish
models.description: The fresh fish is a performance twin fin fish designed for knee to overhead waves. Developed with the Gilroy brothers, we wanted to create a fish that retains the maneuverability and responsiveness of a shortboard with the paddle power and twin fin feel of a trad fish.

models.name: Zero
models.description: Founded on the principles of the Two.Five and Electric Twin, this little pocket rocket is our highest peformance twin fin. A board that carries incredible speed and surfs fast in the pocket.

models.name: Two.Five
models.description: The Two.Five, named after it’s twin fin plus mini trailer setup, is a great hybrid style surfboard that’s guaranteed to improve your surfing in everyday waves. It’s a true one-board quiver that absolutely flies in waist high to overhead conditions.

models.name: Sidekick
models.description: If you’re looking for a board for steeper waves, that keeps loads of paddle power and allows you to push your surfing this is just the thing. The sidekick is my exploration of shortboards from a fish viewpoint, designed to offer really easy paddling, insane speed down the line, while allowing a top-to-bottom surfing approach.

models.name: Hideaway
models.description: A specialist shortboard designed to perform at the highest level for everyday surfers. Tuned into UK waves with a progressive rocker line that carries speed through the flats, and some hidden volume to overcome stiff winds and thick winter rubber.

models.name: Roundaway
models.description: Our ultimate average-to-good wave shortboard with a strong performance pedigree. Inspired by my work with Lost, this board has been a firm favourite on the custom order list, from both everyday surfers to experienced chargers.

models.name: Semi Guns
models.description: Strictly custom order and built especially for the waves you’re planning to surf. There’s a lot to be said for having a semi-gun in your quiver, most simply won’t have the correct board when those big swells roll through, they’re a must if you want to make the most of those big days.

models.name: POG
models.description: The next step in the mid length evolution, the POG is a more conservative approach to getting more foam under your feet, without the ‘retro’ drawbacks. It’s fondly been called a ‘shortboard in disguise’ and offers loads of paddle power, a rocker line you can trust in most waves, but with a round tail reminiscent of a hybrid shortboard.

models.name: Mono
models.description: Narrow, lightweight, and nimble, a performance-forward single fin that hovers between mid length and mini-glider territory. Inspired by the lines drawn by Tudor, Knost et al.

models.name: Mini Pin
models.description: The Mini Pin is a follow on from the popular Mini Noserider. A pintail variation with a bit more rocker that can handle bigger and steeper waves more effectively.

models.name: Mini Nose Rider
models.description: Our most popular and longstanding model, the Mini Nose Rider does what it says on the tin… if you can believe it. A noseriding longboard with the middle section removed, easier to turn, more control on big days, and fewer steps to the nose.

models.name: Yonder Mini Mal
models.description: Designed in collaboration with my friends at Yonder, tuned and proven over hundreds of lessons and years of experience.

models.name: Perch
models.description: To settle or rest in an elevated position, as if on a perch. A contemporary noserider designed for classic logging, the Perch provides a stable platform for cross-stepping and noseriding.

models.name: Cali Square Tail
models.description: Characterised by its wide round nose and hipped tail, the Cali Square Tail follows an infamous outline well-known for its hang time and easy riding. A great all-round longboard for waves from knee high to head high, designed to noseride, turn, and everything in between.

models.name: Quickstep
models.description: This is my do-everything longboard shape, round concaved nose with a single channel through the middle, leading into a rolled pulled in tail section. Slightly narrower with a touch more blended rocker than my other models, but still a stable and stylish cruiser.
